verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party "export workspace" feature. Data can still be pulled out programmatically: Linear's public GraphQL API is the same one it uses internally, supports introspection of the full schema, and authenticates with personal API keys. Official connector listings for Fivetran and Airbyte sync Linear data into warehouses and databases. Leaving therefore takes extra tooling and API scripting within published rate limits, rather than a one-click open-format export. Missing for 10: a documented built-in full-data export (e.g. CSV/JSON/Markdown dump), stated export format coverage for docs and attachments, and independent or hands-on confirmation of a complete migration out.
